Identity

The wordmark is type, not a drawing: the word, in the family of the system. Colour is reserved for what means something — state, risk, attention. Everything else is neutral.

Motion

Durations and easings are tokens, and nothing else moves. With “reduce motion” on, every duration becomes zero and no animation is declared: a state is still told by its key, and within a colour by its shape.

--ela-motion-duration-fast120ms
--ela-motion-duration-base240ms
--ela-motion-duration-signal480ms
--ela-motion-duration-orbit1200ms
--ela-motion-duration-beat1600ms
--ela-motion-duration-orbit-slow2800ms
--ela-motion-duration-step3200ms
--ela-motion-duration-breathe4800ms
--ela-motion-easing-standardcubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)
--ela-motion-easing-in-outcubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1)
--ela-motion-easing-linearlinear
--ela-motion-easing-stepssteps(8, end)

Iconography

Rules only: a grid, a live area, a stroke, three sizes. No icon is drawn here — icons arrive with the views that use them.

--ela-icon-grid24px
--ela-icon-live2px
--ela-icon-stroke1.5px
--ela-icon-size-sm16px
--ela-icon-size-md20px
--ela-icon-size-lg24px
